name: Urna Bose

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Urna Bose works across advertising, poetry and literary editing. Her Poet2Poet interviews for Different Truths place sustained conversations with other writers alongside her own creative work. The Nissim award organiser's record identifies her as the second-prize recipient in English poetry for 2021.

What No One Told Me approaches bereavement through the things a household continues to use: rotis, ghee, a tablecloth, washing-up materials and the taste of a familiar meal. The speaker's loss is felt in changed textures and rituals before it can be contained in an explanation. Against ready-made assurances that time will heal, the poem insists on the particular, sensory knowledge of absence.
